$comment: PRIVACY: This is the ONLY IPC schema permitted to carry raw identifying user data.
title: Raw Event

declared_app_category.description: LSApplicationCategoryType declared in the application's own Info.plist. A fact read off disk; which values mean anything is decided in Rust, and most mean nothing. Local IPC only.

document_type_ids.description: LSItemContentTypes declared across CFBundleDocumentTypes, flattened, deduplicated and sorted by the client. An oversized list is sent empty rather than truncated: a truncated list is a set the application never declared. The bound is 256, above every measured application (Xcode declares 152). An over-bound list costs the declaration only; the event and its duration are kept. Local IPC only.

focused_document_url.description: Raw focused browser document URL. Local IPC only; Rust must normalize and discard it before persistence.
